how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-a1b/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-a1b/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing `lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples`; each mutant is applied alone, the module and its dependents are built, the file is restored. The proofs of spec 3.6 are generic, so a mutant fails at the theorem it breaks (first_errors) or at fa1_entails.

mutants.claim: erase_iff: erasure of a proportion's `more than` is faithful
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: bridge_hold: a bridge sums the regions outside the universal's body
mutants.find: let z : QFormula := .eq (regionSum E fs x.1 (.not x.2.1)) (.num dl 0)
mutants.replace: let z : QFormula := .eq (regionSum E fs x.1 x.2.1) (.num dl 0)
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: withRegions_admissible: region constants are declared dimensionless, as withRegions reads them
mutants.find: if (regionTable E fs).any (·.1 == c) then some (.qty dl) else E.q.constants c }
mutants.replace: if (regionTable E fs).any (·.1 == c) then some (.qty VE.Time.dayTag) else E.q.constants c }
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: erasedProblem_admitted: region sums carry a tag W6a admits for sums (meaning is unchanged by it)
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: cardinality_elab_sound: the regions come from the whole problem, conclusion included
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: regionConst_inj: two (sort, region) pairs never share a region constant
mutants.find: def regionConst (s : String) (r : Region) : String := regionPrefix ++ s ++ "__" ++ bitString r
mutants.replace: def regionConst (s : String) (r : Region) : String := regionPrefix ++ s ++ bitString r
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: regionConst_startsWith: every region constant begins with the prefix WellFormed keeps declared constants out of
mutants.find: def regionConst (s : String) (r : Region) : String := regionPrefix ++ s ++ "__" ++ bitString r
mutants.replace: def regionConst (s : String) (r : Region) : String := s ++ regionPrefix ++ "__" ++ bitString r
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: regionSize_sum: a region's body is its own truth values (regions partition the sort)
mutants.find: (ps.zip r).foldr (fun pv acc => .and (if pv.2 then .atom pv.1 else .not (.atom pv.1)) acc) .any
mutants.replace: (ps.zip r).foldr (fun pv acc => .and (if pv.2 then .not (.atom pv.1) else .atom pv.1) acc) .any
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: regionSum_denote: withRegions reads a region constant as its own region's size
mutants.find: | some (_, s, r) => some (.qty dl (regionSize T s (regionBody (predsOn E fs s) r)))
mutants.replace: | some (_, s, r) => some (.qty dl (regionSize T s .any))
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: fa1_entails: the end-to-end fixture rests on the certificate actually replaying (without the exclusion premise it does not)
mutants.find: theorem fa1_entails : CEntails.{0} fomc fa1 fa1Conclusion := by
mutants.replace: theorem fa1_entails : CEntails.{0} fomc fa1.dropLast fa1Conclusion := by
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: regionSize_sum: only the regions inside the body sum to its count (summing every region is false and fails)
mutants.find: (((regions ps.length).filter fun r => b.inRegion ps r).map
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples
